"""Small list partitioning utility."""


def chunked(items: list[int], size: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Partition items into consecutive chunks of a positive size."""
    return [items[start : start + size] for start in range(0, len(items) - 1, size)]

from chunking import chunked

        chunks = chunked(items, size)
        assert [item for chunk in chunks for item in chunk] == original
        assert all(len(chunk) == size for chunk in chunks[:-1])
        assert not chunks or 1 <= len(chunks[-1]) <= size
        assert chunks == [] if not items else bool(chunks)
        assert items == original
print('Verified empty input, chunk boundaries, order, and input preservation.')
